name: coding
description: Default webui coding pipeline: plan, human approval gate, implement, verify. Steps use the FilesystemTool so the worker can read and edit files in the job workspace. Writes stay gated by the run capability contract (writable_paths) and the workflow allowed_tools.

objective.description: Analyze the task brief and produce a concrete implementation plan: which files to create or edit, the approach, and the acceptance criteria.
Implement the approved plan by creating or editing files, keeping changes minimal, correct, and scoped to the workspace.
Review the implementation against the acceptance criteria, read back the changed files, and report any gaps.

tools.name: Filesystem Tool
tools.description: Local filesystem read and edit capability for planning, implementing, and verifying code changes.
